name: cpp-callgraph-visualizer
description: Interactive caller/callee call graphs, function-pointer tracing, and class hierarchy diagrams for C/C++.

viewsWelcome.contents:
C/C++ Call Graph Visualizer

Place cursor inside a C/C++ function:

[$(type-hierarchy)  Show Call Graph](command:callgraph.showForCursor)

**Class & UML Diagrams**
[$(symbol-class)  Inheritance Hierarchy](command:callgraph.showClassDiagram)
[$(symbol-class)  Full UML (members, methods, all relations)](command:callgraph.showClassUml)
[$(references)  Class Usage Diagram](command:callgraph.showUsageDiagram)

[$(refresh)  Rebuild Index](command:callgraph.refreshIndex)
[$(output)  Diagnostics](command:callgraph.showDiagnostics)
[$(symbol-misc)  List Macro Aliases](command:callgraph.listMacroAliases)

**Shortcuts** `Ctrl+Alt+G` call graph  `Ctrl+Alt+C` class hierarchy

callgraph.buildDirectory.markdownDescription: Path to your build directory that contains `compile_commands.json`, relative to the workspace root (e.g. `build`) or absolute. **Supports a comma-separated list** to try multiple directories in order — e.g. `"objects, listings, build, Debug_FLASH"`. The first directory that contains a `compile_commands.json` is used. Use this **or** `compileCommandsPath` — if both are set, `compileCommandsPath` wins.

callgraph.compileCommandsPath.markdownDescription: Full path to `compile_commands.json`. Leave empty to auto-detect from `buildDirectory` or common locations (`build/`, `out/`, `cmake-build-*/`). When found, the extension shells out to your `clangBinaryPath` for edge confirmation and virtual-dispatch candidates.

callgraph.clangBinaryPath.markdownDescription: Path to a `clang` or `clang++` binary. Leave empty to use `clang++` on your PATH. **Can be a directory** (e.g. `F:\\LLVM-ET-Arm-19\\bin\\`) — the extension will append `clang++.exe` (Windows) or `clang++` automatically. For ARM embedded projects, point this to the LLVM Embedded Toolchain for Arm (`LLVM-ET-Arm-XX\\bin\\`) to enable AST verification on cross-compiled code. Without a compatible clang, the extension runs in pure heuristic mode.

callgraph.ctagsPath.markdownDescription: Path to a `ctags` (universal-ctags) binary. When set, the extension uses ctags as an additional cross-reference source in heuristic mode to improve caller/callee coverage beyond what the regex parser alone finds.

callgraph.cscopePath.markdownDescription: Path to a `cscope` binary. When set and a `cscope.out` database exists in the workspace, the extension queries cscope for callers to supplement the heuristic parse.

callgraph.graphvizDotPath.description: Path to Graphviz dot binary. Optional — used only for SVG export.

callgraph.defaultDepth.description: Default call graph depth when opening a new graph (1-20). The slider always lets you change it interactively.

callgraph.maxCallerConfirmations.description: Maximum number of distinct callers that get an individual clang-verification query per graph load. Callers beyond this cap remain heuristic-only to bound latency.

callgraph.maxVisibleNodes.description: Soft cap on nodes rendered simultaneously. When hit, the panel shows a banner rather than silently truncating.

callgraph.popup.fontSize.description: Font size (px) for the Ctrl+hover source preview popup.

callgraph.popup.width.description: Initial width (px) of the source preview popup. The popup is resizable.

callgraph.popup.height.description: Initial height (px) of the source preview popup. The popup is resizable.

callgraph.isrPatterns.markdownDescription: Additional regex patterns (case-insensitive, matched against the function name or the ~300 chars preceding it) that identify ISR / interrupt handler functions. Example: `["MY_ISR_ATTR", "__weak __irq"]`. Built-in patterns already cover ARM CMSIS `_IRQHandler`, GCC `__attribute__((interrupt))`, AVR `ISR()`, ESP-IDF `IRAM_ATTR`, IAR `__interrupt`, Keil `__irq`, and CCS `#pragma vector=`.

callgraph.maxAmbiguousLinks.markdownDescription: Maximum number of cross-file same-name matches shown as `virtualCandidate` edges (for virtual method dispatch). When more matches exist the call is skipped to prevent graph explosion. Increase this when you see `skipping 'GetValue': 42 non-static matches` in the diagnostics and want those virtual candidates included. Default: 12.
